erayyap-kappa-2026.proof_status: Claimed, not independently checked. The source provides a proof outline: asymptotic chain counts and the changes to tape procedures still need written proofs. Its exact numerical checks and small-parameter gate checks do not establish the full algorithm. No Lean proof. The stored score 406/2^68 is inferred from the rounded source exponent and its dyadic precision; the manuscript prints 2^-59.335.
erayyap-kappa-2026.comparison_status: The pinned introduction states the same deterministic fixed-finite-alphabet, fixed-finite-number-of-one-dimensional-tapes model for multiplying two n-bit integers. The modified cost accounting is only outlined; full correctness remains claimed. Inferred exact dyadic, not an explicitly printed rational: the source reports log2(kappa) rounded to -59.335 and uses dyadic_below(gmin/2, 8). Among k/2^68 for 256<=k<512, only k=406 rounds to that exponent. Source code was read as text, never executed.
erayyap-kappa-2026.publication_date_role: First repository commit stating this bound
erayyap-kappa-2026.credits: Eray Yapağcı directed the work; the source credits Claude Opus 5.5 for constructions, computations and text. Builds on OpenAI integer multiplication.
